page.layout: One column of running text, full width. Running head "DEDICATORIA." at the top. Signature mark ")( 4" at the foot, with the catchword "argu-" at the right below the last line. No marginal notes.

main_text.p: rissimus idem argumentum tracto, inque medium proferre audeo. Non defuerunt, qui peculiares tractatus de hoc scripserunt erudite eruditè viri, nec forsan defuturi sunt, qui omnis doctrinae & laborum conficientissimi praestituri sunt id acrius & ingeniosius. In quos ego incidi, ii vel breuiter & strictè nimis, vel accuratè & methodicè minus materiam illam pertractarunt. Quapropter non gloriae cupiditate, quae praestantibus fere ingeniis omnibus est insita, adductus in tam trito à praeclaris viris argu-

page.notes: The first word "rissimus" is a fragment from the previous line, as printed ("rissimus"). The word "erudite" is printed with a grave accent as "eruditè"; the accent is transcribed as printed. The printed line-end hyphen after "argu-" is kept. Printed signature ")( 4" is treated as the gathering mark. Some accents in the text are faint and may not be exact.
